items.source: When used with JUnit Jupiter based tests, @DisabledInAotMode also signals that the annotated test class or test method is disabled when running the test suite in Spring AOT mode. When applied at the class level, all test methods within that class will be disabled. In this sense, @DisabledInAotMode has semantics similar to those of JUnit Jupiter's @DisabledInNativeImage annotation.
items.translation: 与基于 JUnit Jupiter 的测试配合使用时，`@DisabledInAotMode` 还会指示在 Spring AOT 模式下运行测试套件时，该注解标记的测试类或测试方法处于 禁用 状态。当应用于类级别时，该类中的所有测试方法都将被禁用。在此意义上，`@DisabledInAotMode` 具有与 JUnit Jupiter 的@DisabledInNativeImage注解相似的语义。

items.source: If a test class is annotated with @DisabledInAotMode, all other test classes which specify configuration to load the same ApplicationContext must also be annotated with @DisabledInAotMode. Failure to annotate all such test classes will result in an exception, either at build time or run time.
items.translation: 如果测试类已标注 `@DisabledInAotMode`，则所有指定加载相同 `ApplicationContext` 配置的其他测试类也必须标注 `@DisabledInAotMode`。若未标注所有此类测试类，将在构建时或运行时抛出异常。

items.source: If a custom reason is supplied, it will be combined with the default reason. For example, @DisabledInAotMode("@ContextHierarchy is not supported") will result in a combined reason like the following: "Disabled in Spring AOT mode ==> @ContextHierarchy is not supported".
items.translation: 如果提供了自定义原因，它将与默认原因合并。例如，`@DisabledInAotMode("@ContextHierarchy is not supported")` 将导致如下所示的合并原因：`"Disabled in Spring AOT mode ==> @ContextHierarchy is not supported"`。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation in order to create a custom composed annotation that inherits the semantics of this annotation.
items.translation: 此注解可作为元注解使用，以创建自定义的组合注解，从而继承此注解的语义。

items.source: If a custom reason is not supplied, the default reason will be used: "Disabled in Spring AOT mode".
items.translation: 如果未提供自定义原因，将使用默认原因：`"Disabled in Spring AOT mode"`。

items.source:
Custom reason to document why the test class or test method is disabled in
AOT mode.
items.translation: 用于在 AOT 模式下禁用测试类或测试方法的自定义原因。
